  fallback and legacy app password logic from getBitbucketAuthHeader.
  Always use Basic email:token, warn clearly if email is missing.
- executor.ts: pollBitbucketPipelinesCI was hardcoding Bearer auth
  for Bitbucket API — now uses shared getBitbucketAuthHeader.
- spawner.ts: Native spawner was missing BITBUCKET_EMAIL env var
  (only docker-spawner had it). Added to ManagerCredentials and env.
- execution-compiled/create_pr.js: Synced compiled JS with TS source.

fix(quality): prevent infinite fix loop when typecheck tool unavailable

All language profiles had a fallback that set errors=1 when exitCode!=0
even when the tool couldn't run at all (e.g. mypy not installed). This
made the quality runner think typecheck was "available but failing"
instead of "unavailable", scoring 0/100 and triggering an infinite
quality fix agent loop.

Now parseTypecheck returns errors=0 when no recognizable error patterns
are found in output, so the quality runner correctly marks typecheck as
unavailable and excludes it from scoring.

Also adds stdout/stderr logging when typecheck/lint/test commands fail
so we can actually see what went wrong.

a temp directory, mount it read-only into the container, and set *_FILE
env vars pointing to the mounted paths.

env vars from *_FILE pointers at startup before any other logic runs.
